deputy_prime_minister.department: Office of the Deputy Prime Minister

tierSetting.name: Government Coordination Level
tierSetting.description: Set the national coordination stance. Efficiency focus streamlines decision-making; outreach focus broadens public engagement.

options.label: Efficiency
options.description: Streamline government operations. Slightly boosts public trust but may reduce outreach engagement.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced coordination. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Outreach
options.description: Expand public engagement programmes. Slightly boosts government approval but may slow internal decision-making.

regionalTarget.name: Regional Governance Boost
regionalTarget.description: Direct enhanced governance support to one region. That region receives accelerated government approval improvement.

emergency.name: Crisis Coordination Response
emergency.description: Deploy emergency crisis coordination to a target region, delivering a temporary boost to public trust and government approval.

tierSetting.name: Domestic Policy Focus
tierSetting.description: Set the national domestic policy direction. Skills focus accelerates workforce development; community focus boosts social cohesion; balanced delivers steady improvement across both.

options.label: Skills Focus
options.description: Prioritise workforce development. Accelerates workforce skill growth but may reduce community investment.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced domestic investment. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Community Focus
options.description: Prioritise community cohesion. Boosts social cohesion but may slow workforce development programmes.

regionalTarget.name: Skills and Community Investment
regionalTarget.description: Direct enhanced domestic investment to one region. That region receives accelerated workforce skill and social cohesion improvement.

emergency.name: Emergency Domestic Initiative
emergency.description: Launch an emergency domestic programme in a target region, delivering a temporary boost to workforce skill and social cohesion.

allocation.name: Regional Funding Allocation
allocation.description: Allocate the national local government funding pool across all 12 UK regions. Each region receives a percentage of the total pool. Must sum to 100%.

bondProfile.name: Sovereign Bond Maturity Profile
bondProfile.description: Set the split of quarterly sovereign debt issuance across 1-year, 2-year, and 5-year maturities.

tierSetting.name: Border Security Level
tierSetting.description: Set the national border security policy. Stricter controls reduce crime but increase the cost of living; relaxed controls lower costs but may allow more criminal activity.

options.label: Relaxed
options.description: Lighter border controls. Reduces cost of living pressure but may allow increased criminal activity.

options.label: Standard
options.description: Balanced border enforcement. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Strict
options.description: Enhanced border enforcement. Reduces crime but increases cost of living due to stricter import controls.

regionalTarget.name: Regional Policing Priority
regionalTarget.description: Focus national policing resources on one region. That region receives an enhanced crime reduction, but other regions see a slight increase as resources are redistributed.

emergency.name: Emergency Powers Declaration
emergency.description: Declare emergency powers in a region with critically high crime. Delivers a large temporary crime reduction but damages government approval in that region.

tierSetting.name: Military Readiness Level
tierSetting.description: Set the national military readiness posture. Elevated readiness boosts public confidence but increases fiscal pressure; reduced readiness saves money at the cost of approval.

options.label: Reduced
options.description: Scaled-back military activity. Lower force readiness and defence upkeep, but demobilised garrison towns lose the work.

options.label: Standard
options.description: Normal operational readiness. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Elevated
options.description: Heightened military readiness. Raises the readiness every formation trains toward and keeps garrison towns in work, at greater upkeep that crowds out civilian growth.

regionalTarget.name: Regional Base Investment
regionalTarget.description: Expand military facilities in one region. That region benefits from reduced unemployment (military employment) and a small GDP boost funded from the defence budget envelope.

tierSetting.name: Sentencing Guidelines
tierSetting.description: Set national sentencing policy. Stricter guidelines deter crime but increase prison costs; lenient guidelines reduce spending but allow crime to creep up.

options.label: Lenient
options.description: Reduced sentencing severity. Saves prison spending but crime rate increases slightly.

options.label: Standard
options.description: Balanced sentencing guidelines. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Strict
options.description: Harsher sentencing. Reduces crime but increases government spending on the prison system.

regionalTarget.name: Anti-Corruption Drive
regionalTarget.description: Focus anti-corruption enforcement resources on one region. That region receives an accelerated reduction in the corruption index.

health_secretary.department: Dept of Health and Social Care

departmentByYear.name: Dept of Health and Social Security
Dept of Health and Social Care

allocation.name: NHS Resource Allocation
allocation.description: Allocate NHS funding across all 12 UK regions. Each region receives a percentage of the total healthcare pool. Must sum to 100%.

regionalTarget.name: Public Health Campaign
regionalTarget.description: Launch a focused public health campaign in one region, delivering a targeted healthcare quality improvement.

tierSetting.name: Curriculum Reform Focus
tierSetting.description: Set the national curriculum direction. Vocational focus improves near-term employment; academic focus builds long-term skill levels; balanced delivers steady improvement across both.

options.label: Vocational
options.description: Prioritise trade and vocational training. Reduces unemployment faster but slows overall skill growth.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced curriculum. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Academic
options.description: Prioritise academic excellence. Accelerates workforce skill growth but does not directly help short-term employment.

regionalTarget.name: Education Investment Priority
regionalTarget.description: Direct enhanced education funding to one region. That region receives accelerated workforce skill improvement.

emergency.name: Skills Initiative
emergency.description: Launch an emergency workforce development programme in a target region, delivering a significant temporary boost to workforce skill.

business_secretary.department: Dept for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy

departmentByYear.name: Dept for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy

tierSetting.name: Trade Policy Focus
tierSetting.description: Set the national trade stance. Protectionist policy supports domestic industry at the cost of higher consumer prices; free trade reduces prices but increases competitive pressure on domestic firms.

options.label: Protectionist
options.description: Domestic-first trade policy. Small GDP boost from sheltered industry but increases cost of living through import tariffs.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced trade policy. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Free Trade
options.description: Open trade policy. Reduces cost of living through cheaper imports but slightly reduces GDP as domestic firms face competition.

regionalTarget.name: Enterprise Zone
regionalTarget.description: Designate one region as an enterprise zone. Corporations with sectors in that region receive investment benefits, delivering a GDP growth boost.

emergency.name: Small Business Grant
emergency.description: Deploy emergency small business grants in a target region, delivering a temporary GDP boost and reducing cost of living pressure.

levelling_secretary.department: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

departmentByYear.name: Ministry of Housing and Local Government
Dept for Communities and Local Government
Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
Dept for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities
Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

allocation.name: Levelling Up Fund
allocation.description: Allocate the Levelling Up investment fund to regions below the national average. Funds boost GDP and reduce unemployment in target regions.

regionalTarget.name: Devolution Grant
regionalTarget.description: Award enhanced local governance funding to one region. That region receives a boost to devolution satisfaction and government approval.

emergency.name: Housing Development Order
emergency.description: Issue an emergency housing development order in a target region, delivering a significant temporary reduction in cost of living.

tierSetting.name: National Infrastructure Programme
tierSetting.description: Set the national infrastructure investment focus. Roads priority accelerates road condition improvement; digital priority accelerates broadband; balanced delivers steady improvement across both.

options.label: Roads Priority
options.description: Concentrate infrastructure spending on roads. Road conditions improve faster but broadband investment stalls.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Even infrastructure investment. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Digital Priority
options.description: Concentrate infrastructure spending on digital connectivity. Broadband access improves faster but road maintenance slows.

regionalTarget.name: Infrastructure Investment Priority
regionalTarget.description: Focus infrastructure spending on one region. That region receives accelerated road condition and broadband access improvement.

emergency.name: Emergency Road Repair
emergency.description: Dispatch emergency repair crews to a region with poor road conditions, delivering a large temporary improvement to road condition.

environment_secretary.department: Dept for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

tierSetting.name: Environmental Policy Stance
tierSetting.description: Set the national environmental policy direction. Growth priority relaxes environmental constraints for short-term economic gain; green priority tightens constraints for faster emissions reduction at a slight economic cost.

options.label: Growth Priority
options.description: Relax environmental constraints to stimulate economic activity. Small GDP boost but carbon emissions increase.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced environmental policy. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Green Priority
options.description: Tighten environmental constraints to accelerate decarbonisation. Carbon emissions reduce faster but GDP growth slows slightly.

regionalTarget.name: Green Investment Zone
regionalTarget.description: Designate one region for enhanced environmental funding. That region receives accelerated carbon emissions reduction.

emergency.name: Environmental Emergency Response
emergency.description: Deploy emergency environmental response teams to a region with high carbon emissions, delivering a large temporary reduction.

tierSetting.name: Welfare Policy Stance
tierSetting.description: Set the national welfare policy. Generous support reduces unemployment faster but increases the cost of living through higher public spending; austere policy cuts costs but slows unemployment reduction.

options.label: Generous
options.description: Enhanced welfare support. Reduces unemployment faster but increases cost of living through higher benefit spending.

options.label: Standard
options.description: Standard welfare provision. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Austere
options.description: Reduced welfare spending. Lowers cost of living but slows unemployment reduction as support is scaled back.

regionalTarget.name: Jobs Programme Priority
regionalTarget.description: Focus employment support resources on one region. That region receives accelerated unemployment reduction.

emergency.name: Emergency Employment Scheme
emergency.description: Launch an emergency employment scheme in a region with high unemployment, delivering a significant temporary reduction in the unemployment rate.

emergency.name: Regional Investment Bid
emergency.description: Submit a bid advocating for targeted investment in Northern Ireland, delivering a temporary GDP growth boost and unemployment reduction.

emergency.name: Regional Investment Bid
emergency.description: Submit a bid advocating for targeted investment in Wales, delivering a temporary GDP growth boost and unemployment reduction.

quirks.title: Snap election
quirks.body: A PM-called general election dissolves Parliament and kills all active legislation.

quirks.title: Royal Assent
